# B"H

## Boruch Hashem — Blessed is He

Awtsmoos renews every instant, and this interface should feel renewed without noise;
Awtsmoos.com should reveal depth on demand, while calmness is what first shows.

# Phase One — Chessed Vision

Mission: transform the Geelooy social experience into a mobile-first, fast, restrained, futuristic system whose advanced capabilities unfold only when requested.

Primary surfaces: social feed, social hub, composer, actions, profile, aliases, heichel/heichelos, series/post reader, comments, notifications, editors, navigation, and shared social data/API helpers.

Experience laws:
- mobile first; nothing may overflow the viewport
- every interactive control must have deliberate hover, focus-visible, active, disabled, loading, and error states
- advanced controls collapse into contextual drawers, menus, accordions, or sheets
- animation should clarify state, never delay interaction
- no global selector leakage; each page/component owns a namespaced style boundary
- z-index values come from a small documented layer scale
- typography, spacing, radius, elevation, and motion derive from local tokens
- dense pages gain progressive disclosure instead of permanent chrome
- APIs return predictable data and UI state maps cleanly to loading/success/empty/error states

Potential high-value improvements: feed density modes, sticky contextual actions, resilient skeletons, optimistic interactions, keyboard focus systems, reader progress, alias identity switcher, heichel discovery cards, series continuity, reduced-motion support, safe-area support, container-aware layouts, and mobile bottom-sheet actions.
